project.name: airness-parent-java
project.description:
The parent a consuming Java project inherits. It carries the plugin configuration and the lifecycle bindings, so a consumer states its coordinates and its dependencies and receives the harness.
It binds the compiler checks, analyzers, tests, coverage and source normalization on top of the repository governance the generic airness-parent carries. A consumer updates the harness by raising the parent version and synchronizing the managed files.
